title: claude-code v2.1.316
excerpt:
What's changed
Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK , which turns the ultrathink keyword off
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with pooled_budget on the spend limits admin API
Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Added managed.policy_mode: layered to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each…

ai.summary: Claude Code 2.1.316 adds flags to disable ultrathink and looped cross‑cert drops, introduces pooled group budgets for Claude apps, and a sub‑agent effort setting.
ai.why: Provides developers finer control over Claude Code behavior and budgeting, improving manageability of AI‑assisted coding workflows.

title: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
excerpt:
OpenAI raised only about $11 billion in its latest funding round, less than half of the $30 billion it was targeting. At $1.25 trillion, the valuation falls short of expectations, and major investors appear to be pulling back amid the recent tech sell-off. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic is pushing to go public as early as November.

ai.summary: OpenAI raised roughly $11 billion in its latest funding round, far short of its $30 billion target, valuing the company at about $1.25 trillion.
ai.why: The reduced funding reflects a cooling investor appetite, which may slow OpenAI’s product rollout pace and affect developer access to upcoming APIs.

title: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
excerpt:
Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations.
The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .

ai.summary: DeepMind and the World Resources Institute released ForTy, a global satellite‑based map that classifies forests and land into six categories such as primary forest, plantations, and tree crops.
ai.why: The map provides a new data source for developers building environmental monitoring or compliance tools, especially for EU deforestation regulations.

title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
excerpt:
Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone.
